newsitem.title: UK: LME ALUMINIUM ENDS PM KERB OFF FRESH HIGHS.
newsitem.headline: LME ALUMINIUM ENDS PM KERB OFF FRESH HIGHS.

text.p: ALUMINIUM - Ends strong, but off highs. Cash/threes spread balloons to $20 backwardation, ends indicated at $14/$16 back.
ZINC - Off peak. Cash/threes steady around $100 back.
COPPER - Firmer, swept higher by aluminium and zinc.
NICKEL - Settles firmer, at top of recent range.
LEAD - Higher, recovers from recent lows. TIN - Firmer.
